answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 9161 Country: India Title: I have 19 tola Gold since 17.02.2002 ,till date I have paid Rs. 10,000/- as zakat. I want to know what amount balance shoud be paid by me till date.Kindluy reply at the earliest. Question: I have 19 tola Gold since 17.02.2002 ,till date I have paid Rs. 10,000/- as zakat. I want to know what amount balance shoud be paid by me till date.Kindluy reply at the earliest. Answer ID: 9161 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1191/1191=M/1429) If you have been possessing 19 tola gold since 2002 till date, then you should calculate fortieth part (2.5%) of 19 tolas , and you will have to pay this fortieth part in zakah for each year. If you want to give zakah in cash, get its market price and pay fortieth part (2.5%) of the money as Zakah for each year. Also, you should calculate zakah of every year separately form 2002 to 2008, and then deduct ten thousand rupees which you have paid already and pay zakah of the rest of money. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
